notes: Program is test optional ('No GRE or GMAT is required'); no score averages published. Work experience published only as a range, 'Average Work Experience: 3-5 years', so no single value recorded (the previously recorded 5 with a mid-80 range is no longer on the page). Class profile page has changed: it now shows average cohort size 41, not the previously recorded class size 97. Tuition: published only as an approximate program total, 'The base tuition for this 53-credit master's degree is ~$134,000', no annual figure, so tuition_usd left null. Salary: program page cites a starting salary of 138185 and average sign-on bonus of 25500 for GW Business MBA graduates without labeling the salary average or median and without a class year, so salary_median_usd left null.
